purpose: MultiSWAP qualification matrix; qualification infrastructure only

historical_transactional_reuse_pin.role: qualified historical test/evidence source, not canonical production baseline

corrected_legacy_reference_observed_on_h.role: fixture/reference provenance candidate; F-CI still determines canonical production baseline

layers.MQ-T0: cheap runtime-contract tests with deterministic testdouble
layers.MQ-T3: difficult-column, scheduling and later coupling transaction tests
layers.MQ-T4: long scientific regression, not every-commit MultiSWAP unit tests
layers.MQ-P: orthogonal scale/performance lane; correctness is established elsewhere

status_meaning.executable: an existing qualified test can already exercise the stated claim or exact primitive without production changes
status_meaning.interface-needed: final qualification needs a production interface contract that is not yet canonical
status_meaning.blocked: a required qualified fixture/oracle is missing, beyond merely needing an interface
